_comment: security-ci suppressions. Entries must identify an accepted false positive and include an accountable owner and reason.

allowlist.reason: Accepted false positive (PLAT-4771): github.sha is a Forgejo-generated hexadecimal commit identifier, not attacker-controlled free-form context, so using it to derive the artifact release ID cannot inject shell syntax.

Accepted false positive (PLAT-4771, re-keyed PLAT-5655): same github.sha-derived release ID at build-publish-scli.yml:60 after line movement; source_id re-keyed because the fingerprint includes the line number. github.sha is a Forgejo-generated hexadecimal commit identifier, not attacker-controlled free-form context, so deriving the artifact release ID cannot inject shell syntax.
